description: Model an S-Corp owner's paycheck in four independent stages: first model the S-Corp election break-even from caller-declared net self-employment income, a caller-declared reasonable W-2 salary share, and a caller-declared annual admin cost (ART-713), then compute federal income tax withholding by the IRS Publication 15-T percentage method for the declared tax year edition (ART-338), then compute gross-to-net pay with FICA at that year's Social Security wage base (ART-339), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). The salary share is a caller input; this chain does not decide whether a salary is reasonable, and it makes no claim that any salary used is an IRS-reasonable salary. In the break-even stage, the 0.9 percent Additional Medicare Tax is a stated caveat only, not a modeled term. Filing status and the owner health premium are echoed but excluded from the break-even arithmetic, and an admin cost outside the 1,500 dollar to 3,000 dollar annual guidance band is honored and flagged, never clamped. Federal only; state withholding is out of scope. Not tax advice.
name: scorp-owner-paycheck-check

steps.handoff: Models the S-Corp election break-even from caller-declared net self-employment income, a caller-declared reasonable W-2 salary share, and a caller-declared annual admin cost; outputs include the break-even income at which electing starts to pay and the QBI section 199A trade-off. The salary share is a caller input; this stage does not decide whether a salary is reasonable, and no claim is made that any salary used is an IRS-reasonable salary.

Computes federal income tax withholding by the IRS Publication 15-T percentage method, Worksheet 1A, for a 2020-or-later Form W-4; tax_year is a required input and selects the edition, and an unsupported year fails closed rather than defaulting

Computes gross-to-net pay: FICA (Social Security 6.2 percent up to the selected tax year's OASDI wage base, Medicare 1.45 percent uncapped, Additional Medicare Tax 0.9 percent on cumulative wages over 200,000 dollars per IRC 3101(b)(2)), pretax deduction ordering, and net pay
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: S-Corp Owner Paycheck Check
